Reported €1.3 million in funding through the EXIST Transfer of Research program.

Dr. Dieter Groneberg is listed as a Fraunhofer group manager for in-vitro skin testing systems, and Prof. Dr. Florian Groeber-Becker as affiliated with Fraunhofer TLC-RT. Their founding roles are unknown.

Scaling production of complex skin models may be difficult.
Regulatory validation and standardization of the testing methods may pose hurdles.
